a_negative_result_is_a_result: if automatic addressing cannot keep the advantage, the finding is that oracle addressing has value and the cost of identifying the address from raw language consumes it. That is publishable here on the same footing as a positive result
arms_in_order: E2-C deterministic with model fallback on ambiguity
arms_note: corpus, thresholds and metric definitions do not change between arms

bounds_from_ADDR_E1.note: the oracle's 1.000 gold recall is TAUTOLOGICAL and is not a target: the oracle address is the case identity and the gold belongs to that case. What must be retained is the advantage the construction does not determine — context, candidates, stale contamination

implementation_must_follow: no extractor exists at registration time; this file is frozen before one is written

metric_definitions.abstention_rate: probes where no address was assigned / eligible_probes. Reported, never a denominator
metric_definitions.catastrophic_wrong_entity_rate: probes assigned an address whose ENTITY differs from the true entity / eligible_probes. NOT over non-abstained probes
metric_definitions.collision_rate: distinct true slots that share one assigned address / distinct true slots
metric_definitions.eligible_probes: all 84 probes. Every rate below divides by this unless stated otherwise
metric_definitions.fragmentation_rate: distinct true slots whose records receive more than one assigned address / distinct true slots
metric_definitions.gold_coverage: probes whose gold event is inside the addressed context / eligible_probes
metric_definitions.mean_context_tokens: mean whitespace tokens of the addressed context over eligible_probes
metric_definitions.stale_context_rate: probes where a superseded record is inside the context / eligible_probes
metric_definitions.wrong_property_rate: probes with correct entity and wrong property / eligible_probes

per_family_gate.OBSOLETE_stale_context_rate: <= 0.30, against oracle 0.143 and lexical 1.000 on that family
per_family_gate.no_success_claim_may_omit: the full per-family table, fragmentation, and abstention_rate
per_family_gate.why: an overall pass can hide a failure in the family addressing was introduced for. Overall 0.96 with OBSOLETE at 0.72 would pass every gate above and solve nothing

title: Does imperfect automatic addressing keep the measured advantage of structural memory?
tokenizer: whitespace words; not a model tokenizer, so budgets are exact in relative terms and approximate in absolute ones
